pro_course_detail.description:

This a content in context driven course designed to position you to say the right thing, at the right time, in the best way to win you the job or acceptance where ever you are applying to. course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to the start of your IELTS Journey!

*PLEASE READ BEFORE BOOKING*

*Before your book this class, you should have at least 1 MONTH before you plan to take the exam. If you have less than one month, I recommend booking a more intensive 45 minute or 1 hour class as that will be better suited to your needs.*

In this lesson you will receive an IELTS Consultation with a modified *Speaking test and Feedback about your level. You will also receive a personalized IELTS Written Report to help guide your study. 

During the Consultation we will:
- Discuss your plans for IELTS
- Conduct a modified mock-speaking test to assess your speaking level. *
- Discuss your strengths and weaknesses according to the band descriptors.
- Provide you with a written report so you know what areas to work on. (This will be sent to you after)

*Due to time constraints, the modified speaking test will not be the full test. Please avoid using this trial lesson as a substitute for pre-exam test practice. This lesson is best for those who take the test in 30 days or more.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
As a former IELTS Speaking Examiner, I can tell you exactly what you need to do on test day to get your best score.

Whether you want to practice taking mock tests, take IELTS Speaking lessons, or practice your pronunciation, then this lesson will be perfect for you.

Below is a list of what we may cover during your lesson.

Speaking:
- Speaking Task Part 1 Strategies + Practice
- Speaking Task Part 2 (The Long Turn) Strategies + Practice
- Speaking Task Part 3 Strategies + Practice
- Pronunciation
- Vocabulary
- Fluency
- Grammatical Range & Accuracy
- Mock Speaking Tests + Practice

After each lesson, I will provide you with actionable feedback and practice ideas.

*We will be using Zoom for our meeting. Please make sure to have Zoom ready to go on your computer*

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
There are two options for this lesson, One option is that you will provide your own IELTS writing samples. We will discuss your writing and match your performance with the band descriptors to identify where you are.

A second option is to do a writing lesson where we cover the fundamentals and specific writing skills that are needed on the test. 

*It is highly recommended that you book a 5 pack of lessons for the second option in order to give us time to cover all the material.
Below is a list of topics we may cover.

Below is a list of topics that we may cover during our writing lessons:

Writing:
- Task 1 (Map, Process, Line Graph, Bar Chart, Table, Pie Chart, Combination)
- Task 2 (Advantage/Disadvantage, Problem/Solution, Opinion, Discuss both Sides)
- How to use Cohesive Devices (Connecting Words)
- Essay Structure
- How to Plan Essays
- Paraphrasing
- Writing Overviews
- Writing Thesis Statements
- Vocabulary
- Analyzing Data
- Thinking of Main Ideas

After each lesson, I will give you actionable feedback and practice ideas that you can do at home.

*We will be using Zoom for our meeting. Please make sure to have Zoom ready to go on your computer*

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking - MOCK TEST + Feedback

This is a full speaking test with an authentic testing experience. All times, procedures and questions will be as if you're taking the actual exam with an examiner.

After the test, you will receive feedback that will show you your estimated band score.

We will cover one full test in the 45-minute lesson. The hour lesson will allow for two full speaking tests + feedback.

pro_course_detail.title: How to Succeed in International Business Negotiation
pro_course_detail.description:
Negotiating is a fundamental part of doing business. Making sure you get the best terms for your product or service is essential to making sure your business not just survives, but thrives.
It’s hard enough to negotiate in your own language, but then to have to negotiate in a foreign language such as English?! 

In this lesson we look at your negotiation style and techniques and how you can adopt customs and idioms that are particular to your international environment.  

Objectives: 
- To use common vocabulary used during negotiations
- To introduce common business negotiation idioms (e.g. get down to business, meet half-way)
- To practice being polite (including modal verbs for politeness, the past tense to be polite and other common ways to be polite)
- To practice the use of conditional phrases in negotiations (e.g. as long as, on condition that)
- Vocabulary covered: a show of hands, a win-win situation, meet half-way, stick ot the point, get down to business, have (something) to add, close the deal, diplomatic, final offer, in favor of (something), concern, consideration, under one condition, proposal, consult, decline, interrupt, reconvene, recap, clarify, compromise, mutual, tactful, binding, non-negotiable, unanimous, face-to-face, provision, consensus, tactic, interest, contingency.

pro_course_detail.title: How to Conduct International Business Meetings
pro_course_detail.description:
Business meetings are conducted differently in different parts of the world. Whether you start business right away, engage in small talk, use humor - even something like organizing and how the meetings are followed up are different depending on your country of business. 

In this lesson we look at international business meeting vocabulary, but we also look at how your style of conducting business meetings might vary, depending on where you are and with whom you are meeting. 

Objectives: 
- To use common vocabulary used during different stages of a business meeting (introductions, reviewing past business/meeting notes, discussing items, finishing the meeting)
- To introduce common phrasal verbs used in business meetings (e.g. run out of, reach out)
- To introduce common expressions used in meetings
- To look at different styles of meetings, depending on your country
- Vocabulary covered: small talk, attending, absentees, standing in, tasks, the Chair/chairperson, minutes, prior commitment, run through, take over, go over, move on, agenda, item, input, on the same page, reach out to, break up, brainstorm, run out of (time), close, deal with, come back to (something), punctual, clarification, consensus, objectives, preside over.

I have always been a type of teacher that enjoys encouraging my students to utilize their own individual gifts and learning styles to become a dynamic, English speaker, where opportunities await for each student to grow to their full potential.
teacher_info.teaching_style: First, I will be asking you to talk about your plans and usage for the English language, then discover your language level.  It is important to learn the words and phrases in the English language that get you excited to learn.  For example, if you are an engineer, let's build a project with words.  Or if you love medicine, let's talk thru a surgical procedure or how to fill out a medical form.  If you are applying to a job and need interviewing skills, we can discuss how to stand apart from your competition in the workforce.  We can learn the alphabet and numbers. Blending oral and written lessons strengthens your learning, and after repetition, the English language will come quicker.
